# Governing asset selection v1
# GLOB expands matching files recursively; FILE is an explicit expected file; DIR expands all files.
# __pycache__ and *.pyc are excluded because they are generated bytecode, not governing source assets.
GLOB /home/ubuntu/skills/*/SKILL.md
GLOB /home/ubuntu/skills/*/references/**
GLOB /home/ubuntu/skills/*/scripts/**
FILE /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/INDEX.md
FILE /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/runbook/runbook.json
DIR /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/sections
DIR /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/validators
FILE /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/appendices/threat-scale.json
FILE /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/appendices/zone-registry.json
EXCLUDE **/__pycache__/**
EXCLUDE **/*.pyc
FILE /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/audit/asset-floor.json
DIR /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/tools
DIR /home/ubuntu/brain-marine-news/tests
